item.title: Twelve O'Clock High
item.description: A hard-as-nails general takes over a bomber unit suffering from low morale and whips them into fighting shape.

item.title: Gentleman's Agreement
item.description: A reporter pretends to be Jewish in order to cover a story on anti-Semitism.

item.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
item.description: Bridget is pregnant and unsure which flame is the father.

item.title: Movie Movie
item.description: A satire of 1930s genre movies including drama, war, and Broadway.

item.title: Take Her, She's Mine
item.description: An overprotective father follows his far-out daughter to Paris, where he discovers her wild lifestyle.

item.title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
item.description: Indy meets the young Krishnamurti in India. Then, Indy becomes dangerously ill while visiting the Chinese countryside.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: All the Confederate Army's carrier pigeons have been shot down, leaving the task of delivering an important message to Tweety. , Daffy hears that a television station is giving away a prize to the first person who can bring in a rabbit. Daffy chases Bugs and traps him in a telephone booth., The Coyote tries different plans and different devices to catch the Road Runner including a rocket, a trampoline, a rubber band and dynamite.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington
item.description: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson travel to Washington D.C. in order to prevent a secret document from falling into enemy hands.

item.title: Blondie
item.description: Dagwood signs up for the Army Reserve Corps and goes away to training camp for two weeks...which sets the defense effort back two years.

item.title: Laurel and Hardy
item.description: Stan and Ollie get into a snowballing comedy of errors with their long-lost twins.
